network.name: Robinhood Chain
network.note: Arbitrum Orbit L2 (mainnet live 2026-07-01). ETH gas. Uniswap v2/v3/v4 + UniswapX live; canonical v4 addresses below resolved from Uniswap docs + on-chain checks (nirholas/robinhood-toolkit 2026-07-21). Re-verify before relying.

contracts.note: Verified on-chain 2026-10-09 (scripts/verify-robinhood.mjs): all bytecode present, USDG 6 decimals, NVDA 18 decimals + ERC-8056 uiMultiplier, feed "RHNVDA / USD" 8 decimals, Morpho market id/params match. Added 2026-10-11: ETH / USD feed verified on-chain (description "ETH / USD", 8 decimals, fresh round) for the WETH-quote composite oracle. NOTE: the public RPC sits behind a Cloudflare challenge — use browser-like headers (script does) or a provider RPC (Alchemy/Chainstack/QuickNode) via ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL for anything sustained.

USDG.note: Quote stable of the Robinhood book; 6 decimals confirmed on-chain 2026-10-09

NVDA.standard: ERC-20 + ERC-8056 (uiMultiplier); Chainlink feed includes corporate actions

WETH.note: Quote asset of the WETH/NVDA book (replaces USDG). 18 decimals. Sorts below NVDA, so quoteIs0 is unchanged. Verified as a live token on-chain (used in the WETH/NVDA Morpho market).

morpho.note: Era-2 deployment (NOT the canonical 0xBBBB mainnet address). 27 markets, 22 with USDG as loan asset (stock-token collateral). Morpho Vault V2s gate deposits (maxDeposit==0 for unwhitelisted), so the vault uses Blue direct supply/borrow. The deployment exposes idToMarketParams but NOT id(MarketParams); market ids are keccak256(abi.encode(params)) (canonical scheme, cross-checked against the Morpho API and on-chain market state).

markets.note: Primary NVDA/USDG market (lltv 62.5%); id/params cross-checked on-chain 2026-10-09
Secondary NVDA/USDG market (lltv 38.5%), empty — params from Morpho API 2026-10-09; re-verify on-chain before use
Deepest market (supply ~687.4k USDG, borrow ~687.4k — ~100% utilized). AVOID for the lending adapter: withdraws can fail at high utilization; listed as the example of what not to park in.

WETH-loan / NVDA-collateral market (lltv 38.5%) for the WETH-quote book. Verified 2026-10-11: keccak256(abi.encode(params)) == id (local cross-check) and on-chain market() supply 482033059174398714 (~0.48 WETH), borrow 0. Thin — fine as redemption-safe parking; re-check depth before sizing up. Sleeve: lend supplies WETH; loop borrows WETH against NVDA at <=60% of LLTV.

inventory.note: Morpho API 2026-10-11 (recorded for strategy planning): 23 WETH-as-loan markets exist (collaterals include NVDA, bNVDA, SPY/RBLX/NFLX wrap tokens, and Scrypt scV3-* LP tokens) and 7 WETH-as-collateral markets (all loan USDG, mostly empty). The plain NVDA-collateral market above is the preferred sleeve.

stack.note: Deploy via script/DeployStaticStack.s.sol with USDC_ADDRESS->USDG_ADDRESS, NVDA_ADDRESS->NVDA stock token, V4_POOL_MANAGER->canonical v4, ETH gas funding. Pre-mine gate: verify the canonical PoolManager ABI/flags against the pinned v4-core submodule.

oracle.design: Composite ratio oracle for the WETH-quote book: mid = quote per equity = WETH per NVDA = NVDA/USD / ETH/USD (not the reciprocal), both Chainlink 8-dec feeds scaled to 18 dec; layered session/status gate. USDG book keeps ChainlinkSessionOracle (Chainlink stock feed mid incl. ERC-8056 multiplier + pushed session/status layer).
oracle.note: RatioSessionOracle(nvdaFeed, ethFeed, sessionSource, maxPriceAge) -> invalid if either leg is stale/invalid or the denominator is <=0 (fail-closed). Read each feed's heartbeat from the Chainlink directory rather than hardcoding; equity feeds update 24/5, ETH/USD continuously. Feed prices already include the ERC-8056 corporate-action multiplier — do not re-apply uiMultiplier.
